name: Bakun Hydroelectric Plant, Sarawak, Malaysia (Sarawak Energy)
description: 2,400 MW turbine capacity (installed 2,520 MW per 2026 trade press); commissioned 2011; 205 m concrete-faced rockfill dam; firm energy about 1,771 MW; Southeast Asia's largest hydropower installation

sources.note: Sarawak Energy (operator): commissioned 2011, firm energy 1,771 MW; Water Power Magazine, 12 Feb 2026: installed 2,520 MW, largest in Sarawak; read 2026-10-28
